chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from al-ʿAbbās ibn Maʿrūf, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abī Maryam, who said:
Jaʿfar narrated to us; he said: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام used to say: “When a dog dies in the well, it is to be drained.”
He said: And Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “If it falls into it and is then taken out of it alive, seven buckets are to be drawn from it.”

Then al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, said: If a mouse dies in it, three buckets are to be drawn from it; and if it decomposes in it or becomes swollen, while the water is not altered by that, seven buckets are to be drawn from it.

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well from which water is drawn and whose purity is being discussed
key_terms.الْمَاءُ: the water whose state and purity are under discussion
key_terms.انْتَفَخَتْ: it became swollen in the water
key_terms.تَفَسَّخَتْ: it decomposed or disintegrated in the water
key_terms.سَبْعُ دِلَاءٍ: seven buckets to be drawn as a prescribed measure
key_terms.فَأْرَةٌ: a mouse whose falling into the well affects the ruling
key_terms.نُزِحَتْ: it is to be drained or have water drawn out from it

ai.seo_question: How is well water purified in Shia fiqh if a dog or mouse falls into it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings concerning the purification of well water when a dog or mouse falls into it. It specifies the amount of water to be drawn depending on whether the animal died in the well, was removed alive, or decomposed without changing the water.
